name: tradingview-suite
description: A spec-first dashboard for taking a futures strategy from idea → canonical spec → Pine + Python (generated from the *same* spec) → diagnostics → backtest → vault, with a deploy gate that blocks anything where the two execution paths disagree. Built for MGC / MNQ work.

scripts.build: cd midas_code && ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
